claude.sample_unit: NHS oral cancer patient information materials (leaflets/web pages)

links.outcome: Readability of original NHS oral cancer materials versus target reading level
links.effect: Original texts scored FRES 66.4 ± 7.7 (target ≥80) and exceeded the ≤6.9 threshold on FKGL, SMOG, GFI and CLI (SMOG 9.6, GFI 8.6, CLI 9.2).
links.quote: Original texts scored poorly on FRES (66.4 ± 7.7, below the ≥ 80 target) and exceeded the ≤ 6.9 threshold across FKGL, SMOG, GFI and CLI.

links.outcome: Readability and content fidelity of LLM plain-language rewrites of patient education materials
links.effect: All three LLMs significantly improved all five readability indices (p<0.0001); Claude FRES 81.6 vs 66.4 original; LSA similarity 0.94–0.97 preserved content.
links.quote: All LLMs produced significant improvements on every index ( p < 0.0001), with Claude showing the strongest gains and the only model to surpass the FRES benchmark (81.6 ± 6.2).

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to simplify existing patient education leaflets to a target reading level with fidelity checks (LSA, cosine similarity)

openai.sample_unit: NHS-affiliated oral cancer patient education materials

links.effect: FRES mean Δ: ChatGPT 10.13, Claude 15.20, Gemini 11.97; all p < 0.001.
links.quote: All models significantly improved readability across every metric (all p < 0.001).

links.effect: Original FRES was 66.4 ± 7.7, below ≥80 target; FKGL, SMOG, GFI and CLI exceeded ≤6.9 threshold.
links.quote: Original texts scored poorly on FRES (66.4 ± 7.7, below the ≥ 80 target) and exceeded the ≤ 6.9 threshold across FKGL, SMOG, GFI and CLI.
Semantic similarity to source text remained high (LSA means 0.97 ± 0.04, 0.94 ± 0.09 and 0.96 ± 0.08; character 3-5-g cosine 0.85 ± 0.05, 0.80 ± 0.08 and 0.82 ± 0.08 for respective models).

links.effect: Claude met the FRES benchmark (81.6±6.2), while ChatGPT (76.5±6.3) and Gemini (78.3±5.1) failed; all models exceeded the SMOG target of <=6.9 (Claude 7.1, ChatGPT 7.8, Gemini 8.0).
links.quote: SMOG scores also improved, with Claude (7.1), ChatGPT (7.8) and Gemini (8.0) all above the 6.9 target but still markedly reduced relative to Original (9.6).

unlisted_practices: Using large language models to simplify patient education materials to an appropriate reading level while preserving content fidelity
